plan: Given my value of $23, I aim to bid slightly below my value to maximize potential profit while still having a competitive chance to win. Considering rational opponents, they might bid close to their value. I should bid around $20 to balance winning chances and profit, assuming others bid near their values. This bid allows a potential profit if the second-highest bid is lower.

This strategy anticipates others bidding around their values, ensuring I win if their bids are lower or equal to mine, maximizing expected profit.
